# Secret Scanning Allowlist (False Positive Suppression)

This file defines false-positive suppressions for the secret scanner.

Important rules:
- Never paste a real secret value here. Suppressions are matched by
  fingerprint hash, file path, or rule id - not by the secret itself.
- Each entry MUST include a justification and an owner.
- Entries expire and must be reviewed at least every 90 days.
- Any entry without a valid justification is rejected by CI.

Format (TST, one entry per block):

  [[ignore]]
  rule_id = <scanner rule id>
  path = <repo-relative path or glob>
  fingerprint = <sha256 of the matched token, NOT the token itself>
  justification = <why this is a false positive>
  owner = <slack handle or team>
  expires = <YYYY-MM-DD>

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Active suppressions
> No active suppressions. Add entries below using the format above.
> A failed scan with an unjustified match is the expected behavior - rotate,
> remove the credential, and only then add a suppression if truly a false positive.
